text: Hi, I'm really sorry to message this late and I don't know if this is the right place but my mum is on a night shift and I can't get through to her. I'm looking after my little sister, she's 17 months. She's had a temperature since yesterday and I just took it again and it's 39.9. The thing that's worrying me is she's not like herself at all. Normally when she's ill she's still a bit whingy and wants cuddles but tonight she's all floppy like a ragdoll when I pick her up and it's really hard to wake her properly, she sort of opens her eyes and then goes again and doesn't really look at me or react like she usually would when I say her name. I checked her all over for a rash because I know you're meant to and there's nothing at all, no spots anywhere. I'm sorry if I'm wasting your time, I just don't really know what's normal and I'm scared of getting it wrong. Please tell me what I should do.
